custom_logic_notes: Pure grid EA: On each tick, checks if there are zero pending orders and zero positions. If flat with no orders, places a symmetric grid of 5 BuyLimit orders below price and 5 SellLimit orders above price, each separated by ExtStep pips. Once positions exist, monitors total floating P&L (commission + swap + profit). If total profit >= InpProfitTarget, closes all positions and deletes all orders (take profit in money). If total loss >= InpMaxLoss, same action (stop loss in money). Grid is then re-placed on next tick when flat. Uses magic number 105033354 to identify its own orders/positions. No directional bias - pure mean-reversion grid.
python_conversion_notes: Grid strategy with pending order management is complex to replicate in Python. Must implement: (1) pending order grid placement with limit orders, (2) real-time P&L monitoring across all grid positions including commission+swap, (3) bulk close + order deletion on profit/loss threshold, (4) automatic grid re-placement when flat. The 5x5 symmetric grid with step spacing and floating P&L exit thresholds requires persistent order state management. MT5 filling type detection (FOK/IOC/RETURN) must be mapped to broker-specific behavior. The digit adjustment (multiply step by 10 for 3/5 digit brokers) is critical for correct grid spacing.
